$comment: Single source of truth for the Native Select API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: The browser's own select, styled to match your inputs. No JavaScript needed.

label.description: Visible label. Without it, pass an aria-label.

error.description: An error message. Also marks the select invalid.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A <select> with the Input classes plus vin-native-select. The menu is the browser's own, so it works with every keyboard, screen reader and phone.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: The same three heights as Input and Button.

examples.title: Error and disabled
examples.description: Errors and hints work exactly like they do on Input.

a11y: A native <select>: full keyboard, screen reader and touch support from the browser.
Every select has a label: a <label for> or an aria-label.
Errors set aria-invalid="true" and are linked with aria-describedby.
Use Native Select when you don't need custom option content; it is the most robust choice.
